import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 200005;
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;

    static long a, b, c, minNumerator = -1, minDenominator = -1;
    static long X, Y, N;

    static void check(long numerator, int denominator) {
        if (numerator < 0) return;
        if (minNumerator == -1) {
            minNumerator = numerator;
            minDenominator = denominator;
            return;
        }
        long diffA = Math.abs(minDenominator * X - minNumerator * Y) * denominator;
        long diffB = Math.abs(denominator * X - numerator * Y) * minDenominator;
        if (diffA > diffB) {
            minNumerator = numerator;
            minDenominator = denominator;
        } else if (diffA == diffB && (denominator < minDenominator || (denominator == minDenominator && numerator < minNumerator))) {
            minNumerator = numerator;
            minDenominator = denominator;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        X = sc.nextLong();
        Y = sc.nextLong();
        N = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            long val = i * X / Y;
            check(val - 1, i);
            check(val, i);
            check(val + 1, i);
        }
        System.out.println(minNumerator + "/" + minDenominator);
        sc.close();
    }
}
